description: physics.derailment new: an EU07 without a driver runs at 150 km/h into a curve of R 300 m without cant, a track of 150 m laid on its own in the fields of td.scn (autotest_curve), on an embankment 4 m high with slopes of 1:1.5 (triangles of the fragment). Over its overturning speed (about 120 km/h) it overturns out of the curve: it falls on its side over the edge of the embankment, slides down its slope and on over the level ground at its foot, 4 m lower.
needs_models: the derailed EU07 goes down the embankment, triangles of the fragment, which a run without the assets leaves out (it slides over level ground)
